newsitem.title: POLAND: Kredyt Bank to issue PLN 100 mln CDs.
newsitem.headline: Kredyt Bank to issue PLN 100 mln CDs.

text.p: Polish Kredyt Bank will auction 100 million zlotys of its three-month certificates of deposits at a private placement on February 7, 1997, it said.
The value date for the fixed 20.25 percent CDs, which mature on May 14, 1997 is February 12, 1997.
Kredyt Bank previously sold 70 million zlotys of CDs at five private placements, last with minimum accepted price at 99.85 and a 19.25 percent coupon.
Poland's 13-week T-bills were sold at Monday's primary tender with an average yield of 19.60 percent.
